body.p: Claims 1-9 and 12-16 are pending. Claims 9 and 12-15 stand withdrawn. By way of this Amendment, claims 1, 9, and 13 are amended, withdrawn claims 10 and 11 are canceled, and new claim 16 is added. Reconsideration in view of the above amendments and the following remarks is respectfully requested.

The Office Action rejects claims 1-8 under 35 U.S.C. § 102(e) over US 7,690,378 ("Turcott"). However, Turcott fails to disclose "a controller configured to: determine the patient's relative breathing effort and breathing phase based on the signal generated by the pulse oximeter; compare the determined respiratory effort to the determined breathing phase; and determine an amount of gas leaking from the supply of pressurized breathable gas provided to the patient," as recited in claim 1.
Turcott discloses a system for monitoring respiratory disorders based on a

photlethysmography signal. Such signals are indicative of respiratory rate and blood oxygen saturation levels. See Turcott Abstract. However, Turcott fails to disclose using the signals or any calculations based on those signals to determine a leakage of the pressurized breathable gas. Therefore, independent claim 1 is patentable over Turcott.

Dependent claims 2-8 depend from independent claim 1. Therefore, those dependent claims are patentable at least for their dependence from independent claim 1, as well as for the additional features those dependent claims recite. Withdrawal of the rejection is requested.
Claim 9 has been amended to incorporate the allowable subject matter of independent claim 1. Accordingly, withdrawal of the restriction requirement is requested.
New claim 16 is presented for consideration.
In view of the above amendments and remarks, Applicants respectfully submit that all of the claims are allowable and the entire application is in condition for allowance.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency, or credit any
overpayment, in the fee(s) filed, or asserted to be filed, or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to our Account No. 14-1140.
